sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Player is at (4, 0). Need to reach (4, 8) to test UP from there.
# Path: UP -> (2,0), RIGHT -> (2,2), RIGHT -> (2,4), DOWN -> (4,4), RIGHT -> (4,6), RIGHT -> (4,8)
result = action(['UP', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'DOWN', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT'], intent='solve')
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'b':
        b = n['boundary']
        r0 = min(p[0] for p in b)
        c0 = min(p[1] for p in b)
        player = ((r0 - 21) // 3, (c0 - 12) // 3)
        print(f"After moves: player at {player}")
        break

# Check R
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'R':
        b = n['boundary']
        r0 = min(p[0] for p in b)
        c0 = min(p[1] for p in b)
        gr, gc = (r0 - 21) // 3, (c0 - 12) // 3
        print(f"R at ({gr}, {gc}), pixels={n['pixels']}")

print(f"Game over: {last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
